patch.value: Bump @unbrained/pm-cli dependency to 2026.7.29, audit for removed --all flag and newly-fixed upstream workarounds, pass all quality gates.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Audit complete. --all flag: no hits found in source, docs, README, or CI. Workaround audit: GH-651 (activity bare windows) - activity route does not use --from, no signed-window workaround; GH-672 (context low_level rows) - context route is a pass-through to pm context --depth, no low_level workaround; GH-676 (list --tag CSV) - --tag passed through directly, no CSV workaround; GH-785/GH-792 (health runtime/ dir, --warn-only) - health route calls pm health with no --warn-only, no CI scaffolding or pre-creation of runtime/ dirs; GH-794 (output_format service override) - pm-web deliberately registers no service overrides (documented no-op). None applicable to remove.

patch.value: Bumped @unbrained/pm-cli dependency to 2026.7.29. No peerDependency on pm-cli (left as-is). Audited for removed --all flag (no hits). Audited for GH-651/672/676/785/792/794 workarounds (none applicable to remove). All quality gates green: 169 tests pass, coverage lines 49.54% branches 80.65% functions 44.83% thresholds met, audit:prod 0 vulnerabilities, changelog:check up to date.
